annotations.title: Chile debt update (labour debt, legal interest)

description: Compute what a Chilean debt amounts to between its due date and payment: modo=laboral applies Labour Code art. 63/173 (IPC adjustment plus maximum interest for indexed operations); modo=interes applies the CMF corriente or máxima rate in force each day. Returns the breakdown by period. Use cl_tasa_maxima for the rates alone. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/deuda via x402.

codigo.description: modo=interes only: operation type code; default the certificate's reference rate for non-indexed operations (1.b).

desde.description: Date the amount became due (for severance, the contract end date), YYYY-MM-DD, from 2019-07-15.

hasta.description: Payment date YYYY-MM-DD, not after today; default today.

modo.description: laboral (default): Labour Code art. 63; interes: interest only at the CMF rate.
